claim: BONUS is the "BONUS LIFE EVERY XXXX" display routine; its BONUS1 helper selects the increment.

source.verbatim: .SBTTL	BONUS - DISPLAY "BONUS LIFE EVERY XXXX" MESSAGE

claim: BONUS1 selects the bonus option from OPTNS1 D4-D5 (AND 30, then three LSRs to a table index 0/2/4/6).
BONUSV opens with the four increment words 120,150,200,200 — BCD x100: 12,000 / 15,000 / 20,000 / the none option.
The fourth increment word "is really 0": at Y=6 the life and the display are suppressed — the threshold arithmetic still uses the word.
NLIVES = ((OPTNS1 AND 0C) >> 2) + 2 — "2 TO 5 LIVES TO START WITH".

source.verbatim: STA NLIVES		;2 TO 5 LIVES TO START WITH

claim: OPTSW0 D2-D3 select the number of lives to start.
OPTSW0 D4-D5 select the bonus-life-every-XXXX option.
A two-player start stores NLIVES untouched into player 2's LIVES+1 slot.
Game start stores NLIVES-1 into LIVES — "WE ARE PLAYING WITH ONE".

source.verbatim: STX LIVES		;NUMBER OF LIVES-1 (WE ARE PLAYING WITH ONE)

claim: Game start seeds both players' BONUSL/BONUSM with one BONUS1 increment.
The bonus comparator opens with CMP X,BONUSL — SCORE1 against the threshold low byte, setting the borrow.
The comparator is a BAND: SBC X,BONUSM must land on ZERO (BNE refuses), true across [T, T+9,999] including the borrow leg.
EXTRAL is flagged on every threshold hit, before the none-option and cap checks.
The none option (Y=6) branches past the life award — the threshold has already advanced.
LIVES at 6 skips the award — "NO MORE LIVES 6 IS MAX".
LIVES above 6 hits "BCS 20$ ;OOPS-RESET" — a deliberate watchdog spin-trap; the reducer takes the cap path instead (cited deviation).
INC X,LIVES — one life per threshold hit; the tail falls through to RTS with no catch-up loop.

source.verbatim: INC X,LIVES  		;ADD A LIFE AS A BONUS

claim: DLIVES is the lives display routine — the render is shell; its cap is the core fact.
DLIVES displays at most 6 ships — the same cap the award enforces.
EXTRAL is a per-player pair, non-zero once the player reached one bonus life.

source.verbatim: EXTRAL:	.BLKB 2			;NON-ZERO IF PLAYER REACHED ONE BONUS LIFE

claim: BONUSS computes the max starting bonus scores for select mode.

source.verbatim: .SBTTL	BONUSS-GET MAX STARTING BONUS SCORES FOR SELECT MODE

claim: BONUSS preloads X=8 — the zero entry used when select mode is disabled.
OPTNS1 D7 set (BMI) exits BONUSS with the zero entry — select disabled.
The merged switch bits are masked to 3C: OPTNS1 D4-D5 over OPTNS2 D2-D3.
The halved merge is offset by 8 to skip the increment words: X = 8 + 8*bonusOpt + 2*startOpt.
Max-start row for the 12,000 bonus: 0 / 120 / 240 / 360 (BCD x100).
Max-start row for the 15,000 bonus: 0 / 150 / 300 / 450.
Max-start row for the 20,000 bonus: 0 / 200 / 400 / 600.
The none-bonus row mirrors the 20,000 row: 0 / 200 / 400 / 600.
OPTSW1 D2-D3 (SW3-SW4) select the starting max select-mode score.
SELECT is the starting-score chooser; carry set on exit freezes the screen while selecting.
SELEC4 stores the BONUSS maximum into LSCORE.
Game start enters select mode (MODE=1) only with D7 clear and a non-zero LSCORE mid byte.
OPTSW0 D7 is the select-score-mode disable.
The window steps DOWN by one increment in SED arithmetic (SBC Y,BONUSV).
The window steps UP by one increment in SED arithmetic (ADC Y,BONUSV).
The down-shift stops at the zero rung — "WE ARE AT THE MIN NOW".

source.verbatim: BEQ 85$			;WE ARE AT THE MIN NOW

claim: The up-shift stops at LSCORE — "WE ARE AT THE MAX".
Applying a selection writes the chosen word into SCORE1/SCORE2.
The new BONUSM is the selection plus one increment — the bonus target sits one increment above the start.
A selected start seeds 5*SCORE2+1 extra mushrooms (ASL ASL, SEC, ADC SCORE2 into X).

source.verbatim: TAX			;NUMBER OF OTHER MUSHROOMS TO ADD

claim: The extra mushrooms fill from row 8 at the bottom.
The extra mushrooms fill to row 17 at the top.
